items.title: How does self-service adoption change the platform team's ticket load?
items.description: The unit's scenario has a 3-person platform team sitting on a 60-ticket backlog because every team's onboarding is bespoke. Even on a paved road, a few residual tickets still show up (edge cases, questions) — but far fewer than the fully manual path. Drag how many teams there are and what share of them have adopted self-service to see the platform team's monthly ticket load.

params.name: selfServiceAdoptionPct
params.label: Teams on the self-service paved road

items.compute: const teamsOnPath = Math.round((params.numTeams * params.selfServiceAdoptionPct) / 100); const teamsManual = params.numTeams - teamsOnPath; const ticketsManualPerTeam = 4.3; const ticketsSelfServicePerTeam = 0.4; const monthlyTickets = Math.round((teamsOnPath * ticketsSelfServicePerTeam + teamsManual * ticketsManualPerTeam) * 10) / 10; return { monthlyTickets };

items.title: How does golden-path coverage change time-to-first-deploy?
items.description: L3's golden path covers more of a team's stack as it matures — CI, database provisioning, secrets, observability. A team whose stack is barely covered still does most of the work by hand; a team whose stack is almost fully covered gets nearly all of it for free. Drag how much of a new team's stack the golden path actually handles to see how many days it takes them to reach a first real deploy, starting from a 10-day fully-manual baseline.

params.name: stackCoveragePct
params.label: Golden-path coverage of this team's stack

items.compute: const manualBaselineDays = 10; const daysToFirstDeploy = Math.round(manualBaselineDays * (1 - (params.stackCoveragePct / 100) * 0.9) * 10) / 10; return { daysToFirstDeploy };
